name: Defeat the five brothers in their tombs

evidence.note: Dig at each mound and search its sarcophagus. Leave the empty tomb for the tunnels. The five brothers and walking between mounds are part of this stage.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the five brothers whose sarcophagi spawn them. Identify the tunnel entrance.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Find the Barrows chest through the tunnel

evidence.note: Return to the mound whose sarcophagus opens the tunnel. Solve the door puzzle to reach the centre chamber.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Reach the chest without searching it.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Defeat the remaining Barrows brother

evidence.note: Defeat the brother that appears in the tunnels or when opening the chest. This stage models the fight at the chest.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Confirm all six brothers have been defeated in the same run.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Search the Barrows chest for the icon

evidence.note: Search the chest after all six kills and take the strange icon.
